canonical_question: After copying a track or updating a plug-in, automation controls something unexpected—what do I do?
clarification_questions: Is the changing data track automation, region automation, MIDI CC, or a Smart Control?
Does the behavior occur only during playback, only while recording, or also while stopped?
Which Logic version and exact parameter are involved?

competing_hypotheses.description: Existing or hidden automation is controlling the parameter.
competing_hypotheses.label: Hypothesis 1

competing_hypotheses.description: The wrong automation mode, ownership type, or parameter lane is active.
competing_hypotheses.label: Hypothesis 2

competing_hypotheses.description: Latency, plug-in state, grouping, or routing is changing the audible result.
competing_hypotheses.label: Hypothesis 3

direct_answer: Verify the target parameter identity and plug-in instance before playback; copied or changed plug-ins may expose different mappings. In Logic, begin at Automation Parameter menu; plug-in slot/instance; Delete Orphaned only after diagnosis.
evidence_needed: The exact parameter and whether it is track, region, MIDI, Smart Control, plug-in, send, bus, VCA, or output automation.
A before/after or automation Off/Read comparison in the relevant musical section.
The user's report of what improved, worsened, or did not change.
Current Logic version and visible mode/parameter state when exact navigation matters.
key_distinction: Lane label, slot identity, and visible knob position all need to agree.
limitations: Starting values and workflows are context-dependent and must be judged by listening.
